The baking soda/aluminum foil/hot water method is the best way to remove tarnish without damaging the item. You take one cup of baking soda added to one quart of boiling water.(Either add the baking soda to cold water then heat, or add the soda to the hot water slowly, as it will fizz up as you add it.) Place a piece of aluminum foil in the bottom of a glass bowl or a steel pot, and add the boiling water. Stir gently to dissolve the baking soda. Place the sticks on the foil. The sticks must be in contact with the foil, even if in just one spot. What follows is an electro-chemical reaction that strips the oxygen from the silver oxide (importantly leaving behind the silver part) and creates aluminum oxide.

Let this sit for about ten minutes. If the tarnish is very heavy, you may need to reheat the water and wait another ten minutes.

This will look like magic, but is simply well established chemistry.
